text: Automatically reviews every pull request once connected to your repo
quote: Once connected, Qodo automatically reviews every pull request in your li

text: Each finding explains what to fix, why it matters, and how, with severity ranking
quote: every finding states what needs attention, why it matters, and how to fix it, ranked by severity

text: Users can discuss, dismiss, or have Qodo apply a fix directly to a finding
quote: Discuss or dismiss a finding, or let Qodo apply the fix directly.

text: Agentic Toolbox exposes Qodo's code understanding and review capabilities inside an existing coding agent
quote: The Qodo Agentic Toolbox brings Qodo's code understanding, coding standards, and review capabilities into your existing coding agent.

text: Can review code changes before a pull request is even opened
quote: Review changes before opening a pull request.

text: Agent can retrieve and resolve review findings via the toolbox
quote: Retrieve and resolve review findings.

text: Agent can retrieve the rules and standards applicable to a given task
quote: Retrieve the rules and standards that apply to a task.

text: Adds a native PR risk tag/label in the Git provider to help triage which PRs need closest review
quote: Qodo makes this classification available as a native pull request tag (Azure DevOps) or label (GitHub, GitLab), so you can triage which pull requests need the closest review directly from your Git provider's pull request list.

text: Offers ready-made display presets (Minimal, Standard, Comprehensive, Custom) instead of manual configuration
quote: Choose a ready-made preset, Minimal, Standard, Comprehensive, or Custom, instead of setting each Display option individually.

text: Settings can be applied org-wide by default or overridden per repository
quote: Organization level (default): Settings apply to all connected repositories. Repository level: Settings apply only to the selected repository and override the organization-level defaults

text: Configuration as code via a .pr_agent.toml file at repo, project, group, or org level
quote: Manage Qodo configuration as code using a .pr\_agent.toml file at the repository, project, group, or organization level.

text: Centralized rule system to define and enforce engineering standards
quote: Define and enforce engineering standards with a centralized rule system.

text: Rule Miner auto-generates rules by mining past pull request history
quote: Generate rules from pull request history with Rule Miner

text: Maps how repositories, services, and teams connect to assess full system impact of code changes
quote: Learn how repositories, services and teams are connected to understand how code changes impact the full system.

text: Maintains a complete history of findings, decisions, and codebase health over time
quote: See a complete history of findings, decisions, and codebase health.

text: Can be deployed entirely within a customer's own infrastructure
quote: Deploy Qodo entirely within your own infrastructure.

text: Guided wizard connects a self-hosted Bitbucket Data Center server to Qodo
quote: A guided installation wizard connects a self-hosted Bitbucket Data Center server to Qodo.

text: Setup wizard walks new users through connecting Qodo to their development environment
quote: After signing in for the first time, a setup wizard guides you through connecting Qodo to your development environment.

text: Links task management tools to connect code changes with issues and tasks
quote: Link your task management tools to connect code changes to issues and tasks.

text: Detects UX deviations where implementation diverges from linked Figma designs
quote: UX deviations: Where the implementation diverges from linked Figma designs.

text: Does not train AI models on customer code
quote: Pricing FAQ: "Do you train AI models on my code? No. Qodo does not train models on your code. Your code is used only to generate reviews for your team." Plans list "Strict data retention" as a feature.
